metadata.scope: Static web UI, mobile, navigation, controls, source dependency and test discovery. No workflow has been executed or passed by this artifact.
metadata.instructions: No repository AGENTS.md discovered. Root owns finalaudit.md; this artifact does not authorize SQL, navigation, dependency or external mutations.
methodology: TypeScript compiler AST over tracked-discoverable code under app, components, lib, shared, mobile, tests and scripts; node_modules excluded.
Route groups removed from concrete web path patterns; parameter segments retained. Expo index and route groups normalized independently.

Controls include native HTML controls, common design-system controls, React Native press controls, and JSX event-handler sites. Each source location is a separate auditable interaction site, including conditionally rendered and repeated controls.

Imports resolved for @/ and relative local modules, then traversed through inherited layout dependencies. This can over-associate shared navigation and constants; dynamic imports, computed URL targets, and data-generated interaction instances require manual verification.
Test source references are audit candidates, not coverage or passing evidence. No tests executed in this discovery subtask.
Roles are literal hints and authorization call sites, not a verified authorization matrix. Markers require manual triage; placeholder/demo words are not automatically defects.
